summary: MeshCentral is a self-hosted remote computer management server (remote desktop, terminal, file access, device monitoring). It persists user accounts, device groups (meshes), user groups, remote devices (nodes), guest device-share links, login tokens, and event/power/plugin/config delta and audit logs in a document store (NeDB/SQLite/Postgres/Mongo/AceBase backends), and exposes a JSON websocket command channel ('action:*' commands) plus HTTP/web endpoints whose handlers create, edit, link and delete those records and read them back.
